owner.story: Marco spent 14 years as a plumber for a big Stockton outfit before opening Oakline in Lodi. He still runs most jobs himself, so the person who quotes the work is the person who does it.
owner.quote: You'll get my cell number and a straight answer.

faqs.q: You're new. Why should I trust you?
faqs.a: Oakline is new, Marco is not. He has 14 years in the trade, a California license, full insurance, and a written 1-year warranty on all labor.

faqs.q: Will I know the price before you start?
faqs.a: Yes. You get the full price in writing before any work starts.
